title: Why we should train AI in space

problem_statement.en: Terrestrial data centers face severe energy supply constraints, permitting bottlenecks, and cooling limitations that hinder the scaling of gigawatt-sized AI training clusters.
problem_statement.zh: 地面資料中心面臨嚴峻的能源供應限制、許可審批瓶頸與散熱限制，阻礙了 GW 級 AI 訓練叢集的規模擴展。

key_innovation.en: Orbital data centers utilizing high-intensity 24/7 solar power, passive radiative cooling in deep space, and modular, scalable compute containers deployed via heavy-lift launch vehicles.
key_innovation.zh: 軌道資料中心方案：利用高強度全天候太陽能、深太空被動輻射散熱，以及透過重型運載火箭部署的模組化可擴展計算容器。

key_improvements.en: Energy costs reduced to ~$0.002/kWh, 95%+ solar capacity factor, elimination of fresh water usage for cooling, and removal of terrestrial permitting constraints.
key_improvements.zh: 能源成本降至約 $0.002/kWh，太陽能容量係數超過 95%，散熱完全無需淡水，且徹底免除地面許可審批限制。
